reasoning: The icon depicts two overlapping open hands with spread fingers, universally used as the symbol for clapping/applause (kudos, praise, congratulations) and as the standard accessibility icon for sign language interpretation. It fits tasks around giving recognition, celebrating milestones, or learning/arranging sign language, though the stylized disconnected fingers can look slightly abstract at tiny sizes.
